notes.title: Space Hole 2020: 2024 edition Patch 1
notes.notes:
Small patch to Space Hole 2020

* Menu button (start) exits out of "dead end" levels (before, you had to press "esc" on the keyboard to exit these levels).

Thanks,
Sam Atlas

notes.title: Space Hole 2020: 2024 Update
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] New 3rd person camera, adjustable with the right stick or mouse.  This brings the controls more in line with the other Space Hole games, and Extreme Evolution.  This new camera system applies to all the main, larger levels of Space Hole 2020, and in general makes the game much smoother to play. A goal of using fixed camera angles in Space Hole 2020 was to make the game easier to play.  Ultimately, the levels of Space Hole 2020 are much easier to navigate/explore with an adjustable camera.  Going forward, this will be the normal mode of Space Hole 2020; if you want to play the old isometric version, try the "classic" branch on Steam!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38549856/ff68bb1981019cdaf77aea8d66e2efc158568891.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38549856/39c64f765f72196e0ae540dea2f812b3075690b6.jpg[/img]
[*] Updated the description in Freeform Machine to be more useful.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38549856/e20fccb074f6aad953d0b54109bf31ae98bc3f4b.jpg[/img]
[*] Updated Space Hole 2020 title screen to be more fun.

notes.title: Space Hole 2020 Patch 4
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Added "Very Very High" graphics setting
[*] Added walls to perimeter of Space, making it a bit harder to get lost
[*] Added secret Titlecard to Home key and "Clock" to End key (Esc to return, not required for "Full Space Hole" achievement)
[/list]

notes.title: Space Hole 2020 Patch 2
notes.notes:
[list]
[*]Added resolution, input, and graphics settings in pre-loader
[*]Streamlined the wording & made the text bigger in the opening photosensitivity disclaimer 
[*]Space Hole 2020 now supports 4:3 aspect ratio, down to 640X480 resolution, which will help significantly if you have low framerate (it also looks neat at low resolutions)
[/list]
